# BCA Leadership

> Pan-African leadership network. BCA helps leaders of companies become better leaders through executive coaching, peer learning, consulting, project management, and business matching. 40+ world-class and award-winning coaches and consultants across all five regions of Africa, serving 5,000+ leaders since 2017.

## What BCA offers
- Executive coaching — individual, group, and organizational, with certified coaches.
- Peer learning — monthly cohorts, speaker series, and Needs & Leads matchmaking.
- Consulting — leadership, management, organizational, and governance.
- Project management — conferences, retreats, and workshops.
- Business matching — capital, partners, expertise, market entry, and mediation.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://bcaleadership.com/index.html): the network at a glance.
- [The Bench](https://bcaleadership.com/the-bench.html): 40+ coaches, consultants, and trainers, by discipline and region.
- [Membership](https://bcaleadership.com/membership.html): Associate $600/yr, Executive $1,600/yr (4 coaching sessions), Platinum $2,800/yr (12 sessions). Corporate plans from $10,000/yr.
- [Coaching Packages](https://bcaleadership.com/coaching-packages.html): standalone coaching — $1,000 (4 sessions), $1,400 (6), $2,500 (12).
- [Services](https://bcaleadership.com/services.html): consulting, project management, and business matching intake.
- [Programs](https://bcaleadership.com/programs.html): special programs including Legacies of Africa.
- [Podcast](https://bcaleadership.com/podcast.html): the Success in Africa Podcast.

## About
- Founded 2017. Registered office: C/O FFG (Mauritius) Ltd, Grand Baie, Mauritius.
- Flagship event: the Made in Africa Leadership Conference (MIALC).
- 63% of member CEOs report revenue growth above 10%.
